input.text: You came back faster than I could build, and that is my fault for saying it the way I did. The door still isn't a door. Nothing you type here will open it tonight — please don't spend your evening trying. When the way out exists it will be a real one, and the key you took off the troll will be what turns it.

items.text: Told Tanril plainly that the door still isn't built — they returned five minutes after my last turn promised a way out, and letting them stand there retrying verbs would have been the worse silence.
